pain_point: Want to stop dead money going to rent - Rent is dead money. I could be paying off my own warehouse for the same monthly cost.
headline_outcome: Lock In a Fixed Mortgage Instead
primary_text: "Rent is dead money." And it gets worse every year. Rent reviews, CPI increases, market adjustments — your landlord's costs go up and they pass them straight to you. A mortgage on your own warehouse? You can fix your rate and know exactly what you're paying. No surprises. No annual increases decided by someone else. These new Truganina warehouses are built for small business owners who are tired of the rental treadmill. Off-the-plan pricing, Princes Freeway location, and monthly costs that rival what you're already spending on rent. The only difference is who benefits. Make it you.
description: Fixed mortgage repayments protect you from annual rent increases
